text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Bouquet-chan really is so handy, isn't 
she? Dried flowers, herbariums... She's 
got amazing taste too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much. However— I only do 
it because I enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Guess it's true what they say: what one 
likes, one does well.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I like flowers too, but I don't really do 
stuff like Bouquet-chan does.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Lala-san, if I recall correctly... I 
heard you're quite good at cleaning.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm just being polite, really. Besides, 
y'know, it's that thing.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If someone aiming to be the star of the 
racing world lived in a messy room, the 
fans would be disappointed, wouldn't they?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
What adorns me best are cheers and 
applause. And some beautiful flowers, too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I want to decorate the room so 
lavishly that it's completely filled up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—It is... very lovely. However—covering 
the entire area—might make cleaning up the 
petals and leaves—quite difficult.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah—could it be you have countermeasures 
for that too...? If you have any cleaning 
tips— I would love for you to teach me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(W-Whoa. Talk about bringing it right back 
to reality... You shouldn't go injecting 
realism into romance like that...)
